notes:
Version 0.1.5
- One way facing can climb: Facing has its own Climb milling box beside its style (it used to cut conventional whatever was set).
- Dynamic Mill moves between passes keep 0.1 in more than the stock left off the walls, so the micro lift never rubs the stock left for the finish; where there is no room they lift right out. New setting: Keep off the walls, past the stock left. Pocket links round islands do the same.
- Pockets cut from the walls in climb when set to climb, rings round islands climb too, and a true spiral always runs out from the middle.
- Chains run through copies of a curve lying over each other, walls that are splines count as walls, an oval stored in two halves chains without an error, and wall and island searches are much faster.
